artwork.fonts: Pinned @motionstudies/web public Inter and DM Mono assets; OFL
artwork.note: A static production-renderer capture of the retained dated Sydney pass. No invented objects, stellar motion or provider requests. Typography and framing authored. Regenerate manually from a built local preview; not part of build/CI.

localVerificationNote: First full local run passed 103/104; the existing WebKit stellar-retry readiness assertion expired after five seconds. Its isolated rerun passed in both browsers without code changes, then the complete suite passed 104/104. After the arrival/orientation test corrections, all eight affected cases passed; a further full repeat passed 103/104 with an existing WebKit daylight startup click left in orbit. Both isolated daylight cases passed without further edits.

initialCiRun.result: 103/104 passed, including all ten new cases. The existing WebKit arrival test waited for Watch Sydney pass while autoplay had hidden its panel.
initialCiRun.correction: Wait for visible Explore freely and enter exploration before waiting for Watch Sydney pass. Original arrival, camera pause and UTC assertions are unchanged.

secondCiRun.result: 102/104 passed, including all ten new cases. Chromium arrival exhausted its 30-second overall animation limit; Chromium orientation captured an accepted UTC before the final in-flight worker packet settled after Pause.
secondCiRun.correction: Allow arrival 60 seconds overall; await orientation UTC equality with the exact paused journey sample (including subsecond precision) before recording the unchanged-pause baseline. Numerical and geometric assertions remain exact.

surfaceOrientation.source: Retained HYG 4.4 catalogue and current Earth-fixed stellar transform; fixed WGS84 Sydney observer. No new datasets.
surfaceOrientation.compass: Camera-forward azimuth from true north; a bearing strip. No device orientation or permission requests.
surfaceOrientation.labels: Named records with V <= 2 and altitude > 5 degrees, above the horizon and within the camera. Up to four on desktop and three on phones, excluding panels, compass, other names and the selected satellite.
surfaceOrientation.fades: Progress 0.64 to 0.72 at landing, reversed during ascent. Labels share stellar twilight opacity and Show stars.
surfaceOrientation.verification: Browser checks compare every displayed anchor against catalogue rays at the canvas UTC and camera rotation; verify true-north bearing, bounds, overlap, pause, panel changes, daylight and full journey fades.

skyExploration.observer: Fixed WGS84 Sydney position; custom rotation preserves the observer position, lens and dated physical field.
skyExploration.inputs: Pointer drag/swipe after arrival; primary pointer capture, movement threshold and cancellation guard. Arrow keys turn 3 degrees; azimuth wraps and free elevation is bounded -10 to 85 degrees.
skyExploration.handover: Pause composed journey or camera cue at the displayed timestamp and pose, preserving panel state. Explicit free clock playback may continue.
skyExploration.recenter: Select and point at current ISS without seeking; disable for unavailable, below-horizon or filtered station. Home matches the button on focused canvas.
skyExploration.return: Blend custom rotation into the authored ascent and restore original orbital view. Replay and Watch Sydney pass reset custom direction.
skyExploration.checks: Physical camera basis and continuous return unit tests; native Chromium touch drag/cancel, native WebKit pointer drag and touch tap; geometric star-anchor/compass alignment, selection safety, filters, handover/pause, recenter and unchanged UTC. Mobile raster checks sample an explored direction to keep reference stars clear of compass instructions.

surfaceTrails.ranking: Largest calculated apparent angular movement over the sampled interval; omit below 0.004 degrees per second and below one projected CSS pixel.
surfaceTrails.timeContract: Direct frozen SGP4 samples transferred with the population timestamp and revision. Tail head equals the accepted mover position. Retain coherent old packets and reject obsolete revisions on seeks. No accumulation across loops.
surfaceTrails.rendering: Family colours with per-vertex alpha from zero to 0.34; existing selected 60-second trail remains stronger. Horizon and invalid sample gaps are never joined.
surfaceTrails.selection: Independent identities only; exclude ISS, current selected mover and attachment parents. Honour family filters and Show model trails; auxiliary paths appear only at the surface.
surfaceTrails.layout: Choose visible heads clear of UI, compass, selected object and visible star names. Panning reprojects accepted samples without new main-thread propagation.
surfaceTrails.verification: Four numerical tests and eight browser cases; real SGP4 histories/heads, uniqueness, valid buffer shape, eligibility, deterministic reverse/loop sampling, sparse limits, filters, selection, control toggle, orbit suppression, panning and retained delayed-seek packets. Existing mobile star pixel checks passed unchanged.

quietSky.scope: Automatic surface sky hold only, from 30 seconds into the 60-second composition (two seconds after look-up begins). Sources and worker must be available; paused, hidden-tab, reduced-motion, panels and manual exploration keep the interface accessible.
quietSky.fade: Title, captions, large controls, star names, compass and selected-object label recede over 0.6 seconds. Physical star/satellite geometry, observer, clock and optical screen treatment remain unchanged.
quietSky.pause: Keep one 44 CSS px minimum Pause button. Pause restores the full compact interface and focuses its Play button.
quietSky.reveal: Native primary pointer release after at most 8 CSS px movement restores the interface for four seconds without selecting or moving the camera. Keep the reveal element connected to avoid compatibility click pass-through. Reject cancelled and dragged pointers.
quietSky.keyboard: Show controls is an accessible button; Enter/Space and Escape restore controls and focus Pause. Focus-visible inspection holds the interface; inactive controls and scene affordances are inert while quiet.
quietSky.journey: Ascent and the orbital loop restore the interface automatically. Replay clears wake state; manual handover stays visible.
quietSky.paths: Quiet-state trail selection excludes the small Pause button and ignores receded UI; orbital calculations and accepted packet history remain unchanged.
quietSky.checks: Eight added browser cases cover native touch, camera/UTC/selection preservation, two-second landing grace, four-second reveal, Pause, keyboard focus and Escape, drag/cancellation, exploration, reduced motion, visibility pause, ascent and loop.

openingCamera.frames: Near-Earth radius 4.2, navigation radius 14, GEO radius 24, ISS radius 3.5, all in Earth-radius units and multiplied by portrait fit. Constant 43-degree field of view; physical satellite and Earth distances are unchanged.
openingCamera.transitions: Smooth logarithmic radius transitions at 2.6–4.8, 6.8–9.0 and 12.0–15.0 seconds. The final approach rotates onto the displayed ISS ray at the held pass UTC and captures that pose for descent.
openingCamera.handover: Explore and the first camera gesture/key preserve the displayed pose and distance; manual surface return restores it. Replay resets the authored framing.
openingCamera.checks: Two numerical tests and six browser cases compare radius, orientation, ISS centring, uninterrupted descent, manual handover and immediate first-key movement in Chromium and WebKit.

spacePlayback.scope: Unmodified Space on page or canvas toggles the existing transport without scrolling. Repeated keydowns do not toggle again; modified or composing keys and native interactive/editable controls retain their own behavior.
spacePlayback.quiet: Space pauses the quiet sky and restores controls with focus on Play; native Space activation resumes once.
spacePlayback.checks: Four browser cases cover body/canvas/quiet sky, preserved paused pose/time, repeat and modifier guards, native button/slider/select behavior and text entry.

verification: Anonymous crawler-style GET requests; static HTML identity, image MIME/dimensions/hash, credits, icons and structured metadata. Source evidence, all three datasets and OG artwork remain unchanged. Manifest declares the new 16-second introduction and 20-second sky hold. This does not claim third-party preview cache invalidation.
